hooks.command: if [ -n "${WT_AGENT_HOOK_DIR:-}" ]; then bash "$WT_AGENT_HOOK_DIR/emit-hook.sh" claude agent.session.start; else command -v wtcli.exe >/dev/null 2>&1 && wtcli.exe agent-hook --cli-source claude --event agent.session.start; fi; exit 0

if [ -n "${WT_AGENT_HOOK_DIR:-}" ]; then bash "$WT_AGENT_HOOK_DIR/emit-hook.sh" claude agent.session.end; else command -v wtcli.exe >/dev/null 2>&1 && wtcli.exe agent-hook --cli-source claude --event agent.session.end; fi; exit 0

if [ -n "${WT_AGENT_HOOK_DIR:-}" ]; then bash "$WT_AGENT_HOOK_DIR/emit-hook.sh" claude agent.cwd.changed; else command -v wtcli.exe >/dev/null 2>&1 && wtcli.exe agent-hook --cli-source claude --event agent.cwd.changed; fi; exit 0

if [ -n "${WT_AGENT_HOOK_DIR:-}" ]; then bash "$WT_AGENT_HOOK_DIR/emit-hook.sh" claude agent.notification; else command -v wtcli.exe >/dev/null 2>&1 && wtcli.exe agent-hook --cli-source claude --event agent.notification; fi; exit 0

if [ -n "${WT_AGENT_HOOK_DIR:-}" ]; then bash "$WT_AGENT_HOOK_DIR/emit-hook.sh" claude agent.prompt.submit; else command -v wtcli.exe >/dev/null 2>&1 && wtcli.exe agent-hook --cli-source claude --event agent.prompt.submit; fi; exit 0

if [ -n "${WT_AGENT_HOOK_DIR:-}" ]; then bash "$WT_AGENT_HOOK_DIR/emit-hook.sh" claude agent.error; else command -v wtcli.exe >/dev/null 2>&1 && wtcli.exe agent-hook --cli-source claude --event agent.error; fi; exit 0

if [ -n "${WT_AGENT_HOOK_DIR:-}" ]; then bash "$WT_AGENT_HOOK_DIR/emit-hook.sh" claude agent.stop; else command -v wtcli.exe >/dev/null 2>&1 && wtcli.exe agent-hook --cli-source claude --event agent.stop; fi; exit 0
